summary: Automated-tests sweep: run item chains per repo (implement -> independent review -> fix loop), git is state

impl.summary:
I checked each of the three ATS-18 functions against the four refactor shapes that performance-§11 permits. Only steadyRelative had an honest one, so it is the only function refactored.

- **steadyRelative** (modules/Anchors_Attach.lua) went from CCN 15 to 7. engineLead, next to it, repeated the same four growth ternaries and went from CCN 9 to 1. Both now read two tables, GROW_START and GROW_SIGN, which are built once when the file loads (shape 3, a data table in place of the repeated defaulting), so nothing is allocated per call. Growth arriving at both functions is always one of right/left and down/up (NS.Container.Growth normalizes it), so the table lookups give the same results as the old ternaries.
- **New test first.** "steady: a side join holds steady on y under every growth direction, the engine lead included" was added to tests/test_anchors_steady.lua before the refactor and passed on the old code. The existing tests never covered upward growth on the vertical-offset path. Flipping GROW_SIGN.up as a check makes this test fail and no other. Tests went from 1660 to 1661; docs/test-cases.md was regenerated and the README badge updated.
- **standUp** (core/LifecycleSetup.lua:105, CCN 15) is left as it is. It is an ordered run of guarded optional calls with a call-time argument (InCombatLockdown()) and comments explaining why between the steps. A table-and-loop rewrite or a guard helper would only move the decisions elsewhere (anti-pattern #52).
- **ContainerClass:ApplyHang** (modules/Container.lua:592, CCN 15; lizard reports it only as "ContainerClass") is also left as it is. Its count comes from the and/or boolean expressions in nine lines, and hangModeFor is already a separate helper. There is no if/elseif chain, repeated defaulting or builder to split.

The commit body records why those two functions were left alone. CRLF line endings were kept. The tree is clean on feat/2026-09-26-automated-tests-sweep.
impl.gate: All run through ka0s-bounded. `lua tests/run.lua`: 1661 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped (was 1660/0/0). luacheck: 0 warnings / 0 errors in 144 files. lizard (excluding libs/* and tests/_kit/*): 0 functions above CCN 15 (standUp and ApplyHang remain at exactly 15). Largest authored file is 1327 lines (core/Database.lua), under the 1500 cap.
